description.zh: 按关键词采集抖音搜索结果的分享链接，落盘到 records.jsonl 后批量上报到服务端。支持分片与断点续跑，附带一个定时采集与上报的工作流模板。
description.en: Collect Douyin share links for a keyword, append them to records.jsonl and upload them to your server. Supports chunked resumable runs and ships a scheduled collect-and-upload workflow template.

description.zh: 每 15 分钟采一片搜索结果的分享链接，再把这批上报到服务端。导入后可以改关键词、条数与间隔。
description.en: Every 15 minutes, collect one chunk of share links and upload them to your server. Edit the keyword, item count and interval after importing.
